reason: Intermediate 16-request result on GPU 6 showed that immediate recompute on the other GPU cut placement TTFT to ~0.48s but increased the active reader's p95 gap to 21.6ms vs 11.9ms.
design: New server pair. Repeat the 16 original matched waves. Only the candidate changes to defer-cold-prefill. When the warm location has unknown occupancy and all confirmed open alternatives have active work and at least 2048 more estimated tokens to process, recheck every 50ms for at most 1500ms, then route with fresh-capacity. Recheck without holding the router lock or reserving slots. The candidate uses only router-observable values, not the protected reader's instrumentation. Same early tags, no data from the future. Report both initial and final snapshots and actual consumer wall times inclusive of the hold.
acceptance: Retain every original overlap, valid final answer and 5 percent peer-protection criterion. At every nonzero count, if the baseline produced a successful warm-target response, require lower user TTFT including all routing wait; if control was rejected, require candidate success and report latency without speedup ratio. At zero burst candidate may add at most 5 percent inclusive TTFT. Distinguish connect/read failures from HTTP rejections. No global promotion without normal mixed fleet tests.
